basic_info.description: Look no further than this exquisite residence that boasts an array of desirable features. This captivating home encompasses everything one could desire.  252 Minerva is a 3-bedroom, 2-bath home, with a bonus room all on the same floor.  This well maintained home has been recently renovated from a brand new roof, custom flooring, thoughtfully remodeled kitchen, stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops, updated bathrooms, electrical panel upgraded (supports EV charging), new heat pump and ducts, and professionally landscaped. The home has a living room in the front of the property and a separate family room and dining area, ideal for entertaining.  The spacious backyard is great for bbq or enjoying a cold beverage on a nice sunny day.  Centrally located in the Oceanview area and a short distance to Whole Foods, H Mart, CCSF, SFSU, Bart, M Train, and much more. This exceptional property is truly a must-see, showcasing a unique blend of sophistication and functionality.
